Lemma
[uniqueness of the Levi-Civita connection]

↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-koszul ↗ lem:dc-ch2-tangent-extension

1. ch2:3.6On a finite-dimensional, $\sigma $-compact, Hausdorff Riemannian manifold, there is at most one affine connection that is symmetric and metric-compatible.
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-koszul ↗ lem:dc-ch2-tangent-extension \sketch For two such connections, (9) gives equal inner products $\langle Z,( abla _1)_YX angle =\langle Z,( abla _2)_YX angle $ for every global field $Z$. By section 2, this tests against every tangent vector at each point; nondegeneracy therefore gives $ abla _1= abla _2$.

□
